TO ESTABLISH A PROCEDURE FOR THE PROPER DISPOSAL OF WASTE ONIONS OR "CULLS"'s; TO PROVIDE FOR REPEAL OF CONFLICTING ORDINANCES; TO PROVIDE FOR AN EFFECTIVE DATE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

BE IT RESOLVED AND ORDAINED by the Board of Commissioners of Toombs County, Georgia, as the governing authority of said County, as followa:

That any waste, spoiled, cull or otherwise discarded onions which have been removed from the soil, but are not being processed must be covered within 24 hours, by either spreading across fields in a amount that can be and are routinely harrowed in as a form of soil enrichment, or covered by soil in shallow trenches.

The Magistrate Court of Toombs County shall have jurisdiction over violations of this ordinance, and failure to comply with this ordinance will result in a maximum fine of $1,000.00 per day the violation exsists plus the cost of covering the onions.

This ordinance is effective as of May 15, 1998.

All ordinances, or parts of ordinances, in conflict herewith are repealed.
